svg.title: ProofLab one-page architecture (team iFabric)
svg.desc: The live path with the one in-path question (EP-1's C16 check, answered by the c16 core embedded in each agent) and the EP-0 pre-run gate; the platform's own enforcement points; one contract with four transports; and, off the path, the control registry, the stateless evaluators (the same c16 function again at EP-2, after the run), THE ONE STORE (the platform ledger), the stitcher, the Evidence Pack, the control test and dashboard, the ServiceNow human loop (notify, then poll), the risk register, the AI inventory, the finding loop, the five habits and the three control timing layers.
svg.text: Only ONE question sits in the live path: the C16 check before each model call. Before a run, EP-0 may decline to start an assessed run.
Claim C-FM-01: during fault resolution, the three ifabric- agents meet our declared event-recording (C7), drift (C9) and token-spend (C16) requirements.
THE LIVE PATH (blue = our code · grey = the platform's)
tier, C16 tally, register v + sha

observe: a DENY is recorded; only the
